jobs.prompt: Wave prep (swarm go --scope --wave, tools/scope-commands.mjs, tools/ticket-manifest.mjs, tools/swarm/core-*.mjs validation) aborts the WHOLE wave when one ticket cannot be prepared, so a wide wave of ready tickets never starts. Observed errors, each aborting everything: (a) 'Uncovered test references (add the test to context, or list it in ignoreTests...)' for tickets whose files (for example tools/swarm.mjs) are referenced in passing by hundreds of tests; (b) 'context-not-deliverable: missing context tests/X.test.mjs' when a ticket lists a test file in tests that does not exist in the repo yet (the file is created by this ticket or an earlier one); (c) 'context exceeds 200000 bytes for T-NNNN'; (d) 'API workers accept UTF-8 text files without NUL bytes only' when a ticket with a screen attaches a binary mockup (png) as context to a job routed to an API lane; (e) running a prep error leaves tickets moved to running with no run. Required behaviour: (1) For uncovered test references on a ticket job, fill the job's ignoreTests with those tests and ignoreTestsReason 'tests that reference these files in passing are covered by the full suite run before merge' automatically (cap 1000), the way a person does, unless the ticket itself lists tests. (2) A test path the ticket itself names in its tests list but that does not exist yet is an output of the ticket, never a required context: drop it from context (keep it in outputs). (3) Binary or non-UTF-8 files never go into the context of an API-routed job: drop them from context for API lanes (note in the job prompt that the mockup file is at its path for CLI lanes) or route that ticket to a CLI lane (cursor) when the mockup is required; never fail. (4) A ticket whose context is still over the cap, or that fails any per-ticket prep check, is parked: left in its previous status, listed in the wave's warnings as 'T-NNNN skipped: <reason>', and the rest of the wave proceeds. Only if no ticket can be prepared does the wave fail. (5) No ticket is moved to running unless its job really starts: set running only after the manifest validated, and put them back to ready if the run cannot start. Add tests in tests/wave-prep-robust.test.mjs for each of (1) to (5), using the existing wave-prep test helpers (see tests/wave-prep-context.test.mjs). Keep tests/wave-prep-context.test.mjs, tests/scope-loop.test.mjs, tests/ticket-manifest.test.mjs, tests/scope-commands.test.mjs and tests/s13-blockers.test.mjs passing.
jobs.ignoreTestsReason: tests in context cover wave prep; full suite before merge
